desc: 纸白与荧光黄绿纸片切面加硬光黑阴影的随身驱蚊喷雾详情页
leaf: 随身驱蚊喷雾（压泵细雾瓶）
name: 荧光黄绿硬光随身驱蚊喷雾款

shots.intent: 详情首屏用一瓶立在荧光黄绿纸片与硬黑斜影之间的强对比画面换取一眼停留
shots.textZone: 左上两行超粗黑体标题，其下三枚斜切黑箭头旗标空白位，右上留一枚短标签位

shots.intent: 把傍晚开窗通风、坐不住的那个家门口语境拍成可见画面，承接首屏停留
shots.textZone: 顶部三分之一留白带放一行痛点标题，其下两枚斜切黑箭头旗标空白位

shots.intent: 用一条斜切对角把两栏语境并列对照，让买家自己对号入座而不引入任何新事实
shots.textZone: 左右两栏各一行粗黑体标题与一枚空白标签位，底部一条黑带结束行

shots.intent: 以压泵头、盖与导管微距证明喷头做工与出雾状态，撑起质感信任
shots.textZone: 底部一条斜切黑箭头标签位，其余不写字

shots.intent: 用六块斜切纸片把使用语境摊成一屏可扫读矩阵，让买家自己对号入座
shots.textZone: 六枚斜切块下方各一枚空白标签位，左侧一行小标题位

shots.intent: 把三条产品自述机制压成一屏可扫读清单，内容全交给占位不写任何事实
shots.textZone: 右侧三行清单各配一枚实心斜箭头与一行标题位，其后一枚空白短注位

shots.intent: 用正侧 90 度轮廓镜把腰身曲线、领口纹路与标签位置讲清楚，稳定辨识
shots.textZone: 右上两行粗黑体短标题，瓶身左右两枚斜箭头指引空白位

shots.intent: 把三步使用语境压成一屏斜切步序条，帮助买家想象随手一喷这件事
shots.textZone: 三格各一行粗黑体短标题与一枚空白标签位，步序只用版面数字

shots.intent: 以留白参数单的诚实版式收信任，真实数值与文案全部由商家后期合成
shots.textZone: 五行参数左侧留标签位、右侧留空白值域，顶部一行小标题位

shots.intent: 以一瓶仰视剪影压进硬黑封带收束全页，行动文案与承诺全部留占位
shots.textZone: 黑带内一行主标题与一枚黄绿描边按钮位，两侧各一枚斜切旗标空白位

style.backgroundSystem: layered flat matte paper-cut planes only: one large paper-white #F7F7F2 sheet, one bold chartreuse #C8E600 sheet and one hard black #121210 sheet stacked with straight cut edges, one 30-degree diagonal and thin crisp offset edge lines where a plane overlaps, at most three planes per screen with a light chartreuse tint #EAF6B0 allowed as a fourth shallow layer; never a sky, cloud, water, splash, mist gradient, marble, plaster room wall, linen texture or botanical blur as the main field, no rounded-corner cards, no wavy bands, no pill shapes, never a dark low-key field
style.direction: bold chartreuse-and-black graphic paper-cut personal repellent commerce
style.iconSystem: solid filled angular chevron marks in hard black #121210: double chevrons as list bullets, chevron-flag tabs sitting behind each title line, single chevron arrows joining tiles in a row; one weight only, max six per screen, every mark left blank or paired with one short placeholder phrase; no circles, no bubbles, no medallions, no thin-line pictograms, no hairline square frames, no rounded-square chips, no pill bars, no wavy divider bands, no shield rosettes, no insect, animal, germ, flask, beaker, clock or map artwork
style.lightingSystem: one hard single-source 5800K daylight key from the upper left at about 55 degrees with no fill card and no bounce, high contrast, shadows falling to the lower right as flat crisp-edged posterized hard black #121210 graphic shapes with a hard terminator, one tight dark contact shadow always grounding the bottle, clean small speculars allowed only on the glass shoulder and the clear overcap; never soft diffuse wrap light, never a warm cast, never rim-only low-key

neutral 5800K daylight temperature; backgrounds limited to layered flat matte paper-cut planes, one paper-white sheet, one chartreuse sheet and one hard black sheet stacked with straight cut edges, one 30-degree diagonal and thin crisp offset edge lines, at most three planes per screen, never sky, cloud, water, splash, mist gradient, marble, plaster room wall, linen or botanical blur, never a dark low-key field, no rounded-corner cards, no wavy bands, no pill shapes; one hard single-source 5800K key from the upper left at about 55 degrees with no fill card, high contrast, shadows drawn as flat crisp-edged posterized hard black #121210 graphic shapes falling to the lower right, one tight contact shadow always grounding the bottle, small clean speculars only on the glass shoulder and the clear overcap, never soft diffuse wrap light and never a warm cast; typography is one ultra-bold condensed grotesque display family, tight tracking, Chinese headlines in 「」 at 26-46pt in hard black #121210 on paper white #F7F7F2 and in paper white #F7F7F2 on chartreuse #C8E600 or black #121210, one heavy rule or one angled black bar as the only divider, no serif, no Song display, no handwriting, no pinyin or english eyebrow lines, no dense body copy; icon system is solid filled angular chevrons in hard black #121210 used as double-chevron bullets, chevron-flag title tabs and single-chevron tile arrows, one weight only, max six per screen, with no circles, bubbles, medallions, hairline square frames, rounded-square chips, pill bars or wavy bands; the bottle always standing upright on its own flat base at a constant scale with its teardrop waist, short neck, ribbed translucent pump collar, clear domed overcap, visible dip tube, liquid tone and rounded-corner front label unchanged, the label kept as a completely blank legible field with no words, logo artwork or numerals, the sprayer never re-sculpted or swapped for a trigger, aerosol or dropper, mist rendered only as a fine short contained cone toward an inanimate surface, never toward a face, food, an aquarium or a child, every person anonymous and cropped above the jaw or turned away, generous hard-edged negative space; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented durations, percentages, ingredient names, ages, registrations or certifications.
noDrift: no protection-duration, hours, overnight or all-night wording anywhere, no clock, dial, countdown, sun-moon or timeline shape, no time numerals of any kind
no DEET, picaridin, IR3535 or botanical-content percentage, no purity or concentration figure, no ingredient or plant-species name rendered anywhere

style.presentationRules: the bottle stands upright on its own flat base at a constant scale across the set with its soft teardrop waist, short straight neck, ribbed translucent pump-sprayer collar, clear domed overcap, externally visible dip tube, yellow-green liquid tone and the large rounded-corner front label field all unchanged in position and proportion; the label is always a completely blank legible field with no rendered words, no logo artwork and no numerals; the sprayer is never re-sculpted and never swapped for a trigger head, aluminium aerosol, nebuliser or dropper, never shown with the head removed or an exposed cut pipe; the mist is always a fine short contained horizontal or downward cone leaving the nozzle toward an inanimate surface only, never toward a face, food, an aquarium or a child; every person is anonymous, cropped above the jaw or turned away; props stay behind or beside the silhouette and never cross it; vertical lines stay vertical
style.surfaceSystem: a matte paper-white #F7F7F2 paper-cut ledge and one chartreuse #C8E600 riser block; on the two lifestyle screens one matte #DCDCD2 plaster strip and one black woven canvas panel #121210; no water surface, no ripple, no glossy mist-glass podium, no marble slab, no oat linen, no walnut or oak board
style.typography: one ultra-bold condensed grotesque display family with tight tracking, Chinese headlines wrapped in 「」 at 26-46pt set in hard black #121210 on the paper-white plane and in paper white #F7F7F2 on the chartreuse #C8E600 and black #121210 planes, one heavy rule or one angled black bar as the only divider, max about 48 characters per screen, no dense body copy, no serif, no Song-style display, no handwriting, no letterspaced pinyin or english eyebrow lines
